scripts.typecheck: bun --bun tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun --bun tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.dev:web: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const { join } = require('node:path'); const web = join(process.cwd(), 'apps/web'); const next = join(web, 'node_modules/.bin', process.platform === 'win32' ? 'next.exe' : 'next'); const r = spawnSync(next, ['dev', '-p', '3000'], { cwd: web, stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(r.status ?? 1);"
